title: The Universe in One Year
lines: What if the whole history of the universe fit into one year?
The Big Bang happens on {January 1~January first}, at midnight.
Each day stands for about {38 million~thirty-eight million} years.
Our Sun doesn't ignite until early September.
The first life on Earth appears in late September.
Then, for months, almost nothing but microbes.
The dinosaurs arrive around Christmas, | and they're wiped out on {December 30~December thirtieth}.
Humans like us? | We show up at about {11:48 PM~eleven forty-eight p.m.}, on New Year's Eve.
All of recorded {history/~history} fits in the last {12~twelve} seconds.
Columbus sails just over one second before midnight.
Less than a fifth of a second.
On this calendar, when were the pyramids built? | {10~Ten} seconds to midnight, or {10~ten} minutes? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: Squeeze the whole universe into one year, | and all of recorded history fits in the last twelve seconds.
